gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads friendly and unfussy, its strokes tapering off before they touch. Under Tilt Neon's tube-bent, constant-width heading, a long run of text would feel gentle and easy to keep following.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Bold and loud up top, Tilt Neon draws joins as thick as its strokes. Noto Sans Tai Tham follows with crowded chalkboard lowercase and visibly open c shapes, so a long passage would feel contemporary and unhurried.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet reads approachable and businesslike, with short ascenders, a tall x-height and terminals pulled back from each curve's end. Tilt Neon is best at stress-free, uniform curves that announce themselves, and the body font is best at staying out of the way.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri has a high-waisted lowercase and small round letters left generously unclosed. Tilt Neon, meanwhile, makes every curve as thick as a straight stem, and that dense uniformity is what gives the pair its character.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified, even at ordinary sizes. Beneath Tilt Neon's wire-bent s curves that never thin at the spine, its terminals stop well away from the stem, so extended reading feels modern and open.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supp: Chunky tubes meet tall, stocky text. Tilt Neon is best at its technical-pen line weight and sheer presence, while Noto Sans Tamil Supplement is best at round forms like open parentheses that sit snugly in a tall middle band.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Tilt Neon's single fixed nib width gives it a splayed, glowing-tube swagger. And Noto Sans Tangsa does the quieter work, with wide, inviting openings on round letters and short ascender stems that keep text readable.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tc: Approachable and bold in turn: Tilt Neon's stroke looks drawn with a ballpoint pen, a tubelike line with a large x-height. Noto Sans TC supplies the pair's strongest quality, large open counters whose curves open outward rather than curling in.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Professional but unstuffy, Tilt Neon's hairlines never appear anywhere in its tube-like strokes. Noto Sans Telugu keeps a high-set midline and counters connected to the outside, so a longer passage would feel light and open.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai reads soft and puffy, like a lowercase of inflated glass beads with its rounded letters left open. Tilt Neon matches that roundness, its curves meeting the stems exactly, so the two feel cut from the same bubbly cloth.
